observed_impact: Prolonged inundation across residential blocks during the December 2015 Chennai floods; ground floors submerged for several days.
response_note: Boat-based evacuation and relief camps; road access cut for extended periods.

observed_impact: Widespread waterlogging during Cyclone Michaung; subways and arterial roads impassable.
response_note: Traffic diverted, pumps deployed at known choke points.

observed_impact: Severe flooding intensified by upstream reservoir discharge into the Adyar system.
response_note: Mass evacuation of low-lying residential layouts.

observed_impact: Standing water in residential layouts for over 48 hours after heavy cyclonic rain.
response_note: Relief supplies moved by boat; pumping sustained for days.

observed_impact: Marshland fringe settlements inundated; drainage had no outlet as the natural sink was already saturated.
response_note: Evacuation to relief centres; sanitation risk flagged.

observed_impact: Northeast monsoon spell caused knee-deep water on approach roads.
response_note: Municipal pumping and temporary road closures.

observed_impact: Locality recorded the highest rainfall in the city during a heavy-rain spell (city average around 81.5 mm); rapid street ponding.
response_note: Local drainage teams mobilised; traffic slowed on arterial roads.

observed_impact: Part of a two-day event totalling roughly 426.6 mm across Coimbatore district, causing deaths and major inundation.
response_note: Multi-agency rescue; relief camps opened across the district.

observed_impact: Low-lying core area waterlogged as the adjacent tank reached capacity during the two-day event.
response_note: Pumping and evacuation of tank-adjacent dwellings.

observed_impact: Short high-intensity burst caused rapid waterlogging at the bus stand and surrounding market streets.
response_note: Traffic diversion; emergency drain clearance.

observed_impact: Lake surplus plus local runoff flooded approach roads and low-lying housing.
response_note: Barricading of flooded stretches; pumping of underpasses.

observed_impact: Moderate-to-heavy spell produced ponding at junctions and along the lake bund road.
response_note: Municipal crews cleared blocked inlets.

observed_impact: Commercial corridor waterlogged during a heavy spell; shops affected at low points.
response_note: Emergency drain clearance and traffic management.

observed_impact: Sheet flow accumulated at junctions after a short intense burst.
response_note: Temporary closures; municipal pumping.

observed_impact: Riverside inundation driven mainly by high Cauvery-Bhavani flows and upstream release rather than local rainfall.
response_note: Riverside settlements moved to higher ground; flood warning issued.

observed_impact: Combined local rain and elevated river stage flooded riverside stretches.
response_note: Evacuation advisory for bank-side dwellings.

observed_impact: Localised ponding in residential-industrial pockets after a heavy spell.
response_note: Drain clearance; no evacuation required.

observed_impact: Moderate rain caused short-lived waterlogging at low points.
response_note: Routine municipal response.

observed_impact: High-intensity burst over a heavily paved corridor produced fast runoff and junction flooding.
response_note: Traffic diversion on the arterial stretch.

observed_impact: Northeast monsoon spell flooded service roads and underpass approaches.
response_note: Pumping and barricading.

observed_impact: Low-lying dwellings along the Noyyal inundated as the river ran high during the district-wide event.
response_note: Evacuation of riverside households; relief camp opened.

observed_impact: River stage rise combined with local runoff flooded bank-side homes.
response_note: Advisory issued; temporary shelter arranged.

observed_impact: Limited ponding in peri-urban pockets; most runoff absorbed by open ground.
response_note: Monitoring only.

observed_impact: Extended heavy spell produced localised flooding despite better natural drainage.
response_note: Local response teams on standby.
